Dahej expansion commissioned and capitalised, except one facility; ₹390 Cr capitalised in Q4, ₹100 Cr in Q1FY27.

Dividend: board recommended ₹3 per share final; management aims to maintain absolute dividend.
Management declined to give FY27 utilisation guidance, citing the Gulf conflict.
Kochi-Bangalore pipeline expected by September 2026; Kochi utilisation to rise once connected.

operating_notes.text: Dahej utilisation was 90.1% in Q4FY26, 93.8% in Q3FY26 and 85.2% in Q4FY25; March 2026 was 53%.
Kochi terminal achieved its highest ever annual throughput of 68 TBTU in FY26.
New Exxon and Equinor contracts add about 1 million tonnes of volume in FY27.
Dahej nameplate capacity rose to 22.5 MMTPA on 31 March 2026; Q1FY27 Dahej utilisation was 66% and Kochi 23.27%.
Regasification revenue for Q1FY27 was ₹1,214 Cr; Dahej tariff around ₹69 and Kochi around ₹98.
Deepak Fertilizers contract commenced May 2026 with two cargoes bought until date; ExxonMobil volumes at Kochi have also started.
Petronet LNG signed a binding term sheet on 22 October 2026 to form a 50:50 JV with Gruner Renewable Energy for setting up 10 CBG plants of 18 MT/day each with an outlay of ₹1,200 Cr.
Petronet LNG filed a writ petition in Gujarat High Court challenging a ₹283.72 Cr GST SCN (FY23-FY25) from DGGI on Use or Pay Charges.

timeline.summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited’s promoter, **V. Kala Vaidyanathan**, declared no encumbrance on Petronet LNG shares under SEBI’s takeover rules for FY2026.
Petronet LNG received ICRA AAA (Stable) rating for a ₹12,000 Cr rupee term loan and reaffirmations totalling ₹15,000 Cr in credit limits.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹9,442.09 Cr (-23.3% YoY), net profit ₹1,370.74 Cr.
Petronet LNG Limited held a post-results conference call on 5th May 2026 at 11:30 AM (IST) for Q4FY26 and FY26 audited results.
Petronet LNG's Q4FY26 earnings call (5 May 2026) reported record quarterly PAT of ₹1,338 Cr, guided FY27 capex at ₹9,000 Cr and flagged March Dahej utilisation at 53%.
CRISIL Ratings assigned CRISIL AAA/Stable on 12 May 2026 to Petronet LNG's ₹12,000 Cr rupee term loan, matching ICRA's April AAA (Stable) on the same facility.
Petronet LNG Limited’s **Rajan Kapur (GGM & President - Company Secretary)** scheduled investor conferences on **27.05.2026, 28.05.2026, and 02.06.2026** in Mumbai.
Petronet LNG announced postal ballot voting results approving the appointment of Deepak Gupta as Nominee Director.
Petronet LNG's Q1FY27 call (13 Aug 2026) reported consolidated PAT of ₹1,137 Cr, up 33% YoY, on trading and inventory gains despite lower volumes from Qatar force majeure.
Petronet LNG announced its board meeting for 2 November 2026 to approve Q2FY27 financial results.
Petronet LNG signed a binding term sheet with Gruner Renewable Energy on October 22, 2026, to form a 50:50 joint venture for setting up 10 CBG plants with an outlay of ₹1,200 Cr.
Petronet LNG filed a writ petition in the Gujarat High Court on October 30, 2026, challenging a DGGI show cause notice demanding ₹283.72 Cr in GST on Use or Pay Charges.
